forecaster_note: Sun: SE swell has eased right back — mix of NE and S windswells, nothing major but chest-high sets on the better banks. S wind at dawn so tuck into a Sth corner; onshores through the arvo add texture. Mon: small windswells, waist high on the better banks, clean until the high tide; NE chop in the arvo. Tue: southerly change whips up S winds mid-morning — get in early; messy by noon. Wed: short-period S swell may build with strong S gusts. — Surfline forecaster (Max Stanley-Jones, Sun 11 Oct)
